name: Myanmar
famous_for: Over 2,000 ancient Buddhist temples across the plains of Bagan, gold-leaf Shwedagon Pagoda, and leg-rowing Inle Lake fishermen.
tourists: Approx. 1.8M visitors; famous for Bagan sunrise hot-air balloons, Shwedagon Pagoda in Yangon, and U Bein teak bridge.
must_know: Thanaka, a natural yellowish-white cosmetic paste made from ground bark, is worn on the faces of women and children for sun protection.
fun_fact: The Shwedagon Pagoda in Yangon is plated with thousands of genuine gold bars and its pinnacle is crowned with 5,448 diamonds.
